notes.title: Early Access Major Update #1
notes.content:
Dear Destiny's Sword Community,

We hope this message finds you in good spirits and excellent health. Today, we have an important update to share about the development of Destiny's Sword.

First and foremost, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude for your support throughout our development process. Your encouragement, feedback, and enthusiasm have been the driving force behind our continued efforts to create a truly unique gaming experience.

As many of you know, the road to creating Destiny's Sword has been a challenging one. We set out with ambitious plans and dreams, but along the way, we faced numerous hurdles and setbacks, including being unable to raise the funding necessary to complete the MMO experience we had hoped to provide. 

Nevertheless, our team has remained steadfast in our commitment to deliver a game that we can all be proud of.

The funding shortfall forced us to pivot from our original plans. We cut the 3D and multiplayer functionality from the first versions of the game, allowing us to focus on creating a single-player, living narrative, graphic adventure experience that embodies the essence of Destiny's Sword.

We are thrilled to say that this first version of Destiny's Sword has reached a state that we are truly proud of. We feel the game's unique Insight Engine psychological simulation, coupled with our immersive 2D artwork, offers an engaging and captivating narrative adventure. The story and characters evolve based on your actions and decisions, creating a personalized experience for each player.

As we continue to strive to secure funding to expand and enhance Destiny's Sword, your support is essential. If you have tried the game earlier during its early access phase, we urge you to give it another try. Experience the latest version of Destiny's Sword, and if you enjoy the journey, we kindly request you to leave a positive review. Positive reviews are instrumental in attracting funding partners who can help us bring our grand vision to life.

We genuinely believe that Destiny's Sword has the potential to become something special, and we are excited about the future possibilities. Your support and feedback remain invaluable as we navigate this chapter in our journey.

Thank you once again for being an essential part of the Destiny's Sword community. Your enthusiasm and encouragement have kept us going, even during the most challenging moments. 

We look forward to sharing more exciting updates and progress with you in the coming months.

With heartfelt appreciation,

The 2Dogs Development team

notes.title: Livestream with developers and the author M. D. Cooper
notes.content:
On this Saturday, 22nd of October, we will host our first Early Access livestream!

Join the developers of Destiny's Sword, the author of the story - M. D. Cooper - and other guests to hear how the game actually has been made up until this point and what are the next steps. 

Destiny's Sword is written by the immensely talented author M. D. Cooper who is known from for example her Aeon 14 books. Check out all her books and profile on the website here: [url=https://www.aeon14.com]https://www.aeon14.com[/url]

The game is developed by 2Dogs Games, a Canadian ensemble of game industry veterans who all share the passion for scifi and deep, immersive storytelling.

The scenes of the game and the handling of emotional fallout of warfare has been consulted with physicians and war veterans. The advisory the team has received has been invaluable: it has enabled the game to be as close to real life situations as possible.

Watch the livestream here on Steam and join the chat or watch it later [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCdQYiV-Ln2wMaN69If8MtYw]here on YouTube[/url].

notes.title: A Leader is Wanted: Destiny’s Sword Lands on Early Access
notes.content:
[h1]You have already been the hero. Now is the time to be the leader.
[/h1]

[previewyoutube=v4FKz6E_Zuc;full][/previewyoutube]

You know the drill: start a campaign and kick off the first mission. You’re ordered to take your team of peacekeeping soldiers and handle a series of riots as cleanly as possible, without any civilian casualties. But when the action starts, everything goes sideways and now you must decide whether to shoot or talk your way to get back in one piece.

Sometimes the worst wounds are not visible – surviving the mission is only the first challenge. In Destiny’s Sword you manage your team through the highs and lows of combat, making sure your troops are in the right frame of mind to bring peace to the planet Cypris.

Destiny’s Sword is a living, graphic adventure with rich narrative gameplay in which empathy is your most powerful tool.

“The living-narrative gameplay of Destiny’s Sword means your actions don’t just affect the story, they affect your team emotionally. As their leader, you have to get to know them–find their strengths, help them overcome their weaknesses, and support them through difficult situations in order to accomplish your goals.”, describes Ken Hall, the creative director of Destiny's Sword.

The story is written by New York Times bestselling author M. D. Cooper, and the studio has been consulting with psychologists and war veterans to make sure the characters’ personalities and reactions are realistic and respectful. 

The studio behind Destiny’s Sword is 2Dogs Games from Ontario, Canada. The studio is run by long-time game industry veterans, who all share a passion for deep, story-rich adventures and sci-fi.

The game is fully feature-complete, but will receive new content and new chapters in the full release in Spring, 2023. “Including the player community and their feedback in the story’s evolution is very exciting for us. The story is a living one, so this is the perfect opportunity to let our fans jump into the development process from the first steps onward”, says Sami Mikkola from the game’s publishers, Bonus Stage Publishing.

Facts:
[list]
[*] Destiny’s Sword is a graphic sci-fi adventure with RPG progression and rich narrative gameplay
[*] Coming out in Steam’s Early Access on October 17th
[*] Price in Early Access 8.99 USD/EUR
[*] Developed by 2Dogs (Canada)
[*] Published by Bonus Stage Publishing (Finland)
[/list]

notes.title: NEW BUILD is Live! + Exploring Character Personalities in Destiny's Sword
notes.content:
Hey folx! We've just released the new build of our demo! Check it out and let us know what you think!

For a more in-depth look at the character diversity in [i]Destiny's Sword[/i] we've also released a new video exploring our Insight Engine and how personalities are created (see below). From battlefield to bunks, Engineering Bay to Medical, every event the NPC DS-Trooper experiences impacts how they behave going forward, allowing us an infinite number of unique NPCs. [url=https://gleam.io/kHIsX/destinys-sword-pax-online-promotion]If you have not signed up to make your own unique DS-Trooper click here!  [/url]

Judgement calls and last minute victories are not exclusive to the battlefield, [i]Destiny's Sword[/i] puts the lives and well being of your troops in your hands, whether you are planning the next battle strategy or forming a team of highly skilled medical officers, each choice will have a lasting impact.

[previewyoutube=hkK06mkef8Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We believe that your choices should have long lasting, dynamic impacts within the game world.  
Your Troopers can have one of three specializations, each one matches a core element of the game:

[list]
[*] Combat Troopers are most often found on the battlefield, either going head to head for resource control, or holding the backline as the first line of defense. As the commander your job is to assemble and operate the right team for the job.  Your choices before, during, and after each engagement counts.

[*] Medical Troopers are there to catch you when you fall, that is to say when something doesn’t go to plan, troops do go to Medical.  Bandaging a cut, setting a broken bone, it takes a team to save a life.  In Destiny Sword that team is there for your entire guild, you will need the right skills and preparation if you plan to keep your Troops for the long haul.

[*] Engineer Troopers are there to make sure you never need that trip to Medical.  Whether it is developing new upgrades for the entire guild, or salvaging mechs for the battlefield, Engineers are at the ready to provide the tools needed to get the job done right.  Customize your specializations to build a squad as unique as your combat strategy.
[/list]

The mixture of Infinite Dynamic NPCs personalities gives Destiny’s Sword a living narrative that will be unique for every player, every time.  Every choice, and every lesson in the game will leave a mark on your experience.  Our Steam Wishlisters are invited to [url=https://gleam.io/kHIsX/destinys-sword-pax-online-promotion]Create a Character[/url] and we will add their character to the next phase of the game! We hope you will help us make every NPC as unique as possible! 

Thanks for joining us on the journey!

- [i]Destiny's Sword[/i] team at 2Dogs Games

notes.title: The Alpha build of Destiny's Sword is LIVE for PAXonline!
notes.content:
2Dogs Games is pleased to announce that the Alpha build for our genre-bending social and strategic RPG [i]Destiny’s Sword[/i] is LIVE!!! The team has been hard at work over the last several months and is thrilled to announce our brand new public demo that features all-new gameplay, updated features and content. 

[previewyoutube=IS0c22nFghw;leftthumb]https://youtu.be/IS0c22nFghw [/previewyoutube]

[i]Destiny’s Sword[/i] occupies a unique space in gaming today. Our team is proud supporters of veterans around the world whose courageous stories of both active- and post-service life have inspired the game. We've worked tirelessly with mental health organizations like Take This and the veterans’ support group Spartan Wellness to ensure we approach mental health and the long term impact of combat with dignity and respect.

As a part of PAX Online, we are inviting you to make your own character that will become a part of the prequel novel! Your character will be based on your input and used to test the game as we move towards launch. [url=https://gleam.io/kHIsX/destinys-sword-pax-online-promotion]Wishlisters[/url] will receive ongoing monthly field reports covering their character’s progress & events, showing the depth of changes that will build the living narrative of [i]Destiny's Sword[/i]!

In addition during PAX, 2Dogs will be giving away copies of renowned Sci-Fi scribe M.D. Cooper’s prequel novel, [i]Lucidium Run[/i]!

[url=https://gleam.io/kHIsX/destinys-sword-pax-online-promotion]CLICK HERE TO PARTICIPATE.[/url]

The unique perspective of the game is being brought to life through a series of space opera novels being written exclusively for 2Dogs Games by best-selling author M. D. Cooper. Against this rich backdrop every one of the thousands of players shapes their unique story, intertwined with the other players’ experiences - all vying for the opportunity to play their way into the next novel in the ongoing series. 

So... what are you waiting for!? [url=https://gleam.io/kHIsX/destinys-sword-pax-online-promotion]Find out why critics are calling Destiny’s Sword “an MMO with a heart”! [/url]

Thank you all for joining us on this journey!

Best,

The [i]Destiny's Sword[/i] team at 2Dogs Games

notes.title: Play the Destiny's Sword pre-alpha demo!
notes.content:
In time for remembrance day/veterans day, we're releasing our PAX West pre-alpha playable demo on Steam to the general public.

Please enjoy the demo, but bear in mind that it is an early pre-alpha build.

This demo offers a taste of what the gameplay will feel like – eventually the combat will be much more tactical and animated; interactions with the characters will be more nuanced and feature a greater variety of subjects and responses; and the gameplay will be persistent and the characters will evolve with their experiences.

This demo build is only a single player experience, but the final game will be online and will offer lots of player to player interaction (PvP, cooperative PvE, opposed PvE quests and more!).

For now though, have fun and please feel free to give us your feedback on our Discord channel: https://discord.gg/destinyssword

...and please don't forget to [b][i]add us to your Wishlist![/i][/b]

Thanks again for your support, we couldn’t do this without you!
